task1.title: Request for a letter of recommendation
task1.prompt: You are applying for a job in a new company and need a letter of recommendation from your previous employer. Write a letter to your former boss requesting this. In your letter, you should explain what the job is, why you are interested in it, and why you think a recommendation from them would be beneficial. Be polite and express your gratitude for their support.

task2.title: The Impact of Technology on Education
task2.prompt: Some people argue that technology has made education more accessible and efficient, while others believe it has led to a decline in the quality of education. Discuss both views and give your opinion. In your essay, consider how technology affects the learning environment, the role of teachers, and the student experience.
